requirements.statement: A Shopper can browse the product catalog without signing in

criteria.must: The catalog page is reachable without an active sign-in session
The catalog lists only pieces currently available for sale

requirements.statement: A Shopper can view a detailed product page showing photos, description, price, and availability

criteria.must: Opening a catalog item navigates to a product detail page
The product detail page shows a photo, description, price, and availability status

requirements.statement: A Shopper can add a piece to a cart

criteria.must: Adding a product from its detail page places it in the cart
A sold-out or already-purchased piece cannot be added to the cart

requirements.statement: A Shopper can review and adjust their cart before checking out

criteria.must: The cart page lists each added item with its price
Removing an item from the cart updates the displayed total
The cart shows a total that reflects the sum of item prices plus flat-rate shipping

requirements.statement: A Shopper must sign in via SSO before completing checkout

criteria.must: Proceeding from the cart to checkout without an active session redirects to sign-in
After a successful sign-in, the Shopper returns to the checkout flow

requirements.statement: A signed-in Shopper can enter shipping and payment details and place an order

criteria.must: Checkout requires a shipping address and payment details before submission
Submitting valid shipping and payment details creates an order
Submitting checkout with declined payment details does not create an order and shows an error

requirements.statement: A Shopper receives an order confirmation after purchase

criteria.must: Placing an order shows an on-screen order confirmation
Placing an order triggers a confirmation email to the Shopper

requirements.statement: A Shopper can view their past orders and each order's status

criteria.must: The order history page lists only the signed-in Shopper's own orders
Each listed order shows its current fulfillment status

requirements.statement: The Store Owner must sign in via SSO to manage the store

criteria.must: The catalog and order management views are unreachable without an active Store Owner session

requirements.statement: The Store Owner can add, edit, and remove product listings

criteria.must: The Store Owner can create a new product listing with name, description, and price
The Store Owner can edit an existing product listing's fields
The Store Owner can remove a product listing

requirements.statement: A purchased piece is automatically removed from the public catalog

criteria.must: Immediately after an order is placed, the purchased piece no longer appears in the public catalog
A piece already purchased by another Shopper cannot be added to a different cart

requirements.statement: The Store Owner can view incoming orders

criteria.must: The order management view lists all orders across all Shoppers

requirements.statement: The Store Owner can update an order's fulfillment status through new, shipped, and delivered

criteria.must: The Store Owner can change an order's status from new to shipped
The Store Owner can change an order's status from shipped to delivered
The Shopper's own order history reflects the updated status
